label: Codex Iuris Canonici cann. 750 §1 and 751: what is contained in the word of God and proposed as…
paraphrase: Codex Iuris Canonici cann. 750 §1 and 751: what is contained in the word of God and proposed as divinely revealed by the solemn or the ordinary and universal magisterium is to be believed with divine and catholic faith, and all are bound to avoid contrary doctrines; heresy is the obstinate denial, after baptism, of a truth to be believed with divine and catholic faith, or obstinate doubt about it.
